_meta.name: Operation Nightfall — Ground Truth Specification
_meta.classification: DEV/TEST ONLY — NOT FOR PRODUCTION USE
_meta.warning: This file is a deterministic validation specification for the AI Detective agent. No production investigation component should read this file to make decisions. It exists solely to validate agent reasoning during development and testing.

primary_suspect.name: Daniel Mercer
primary_suspect.status: Primary individual of interest — not yet charged

secondary_person_of_interest.name: Marcus Vale
secondary_person_of_interest.connection: Received 4 payments totalling £10,300 from Daniel Mercer labelled 'consultancy' with no legitimate arrangement on record. As Operations Manager, Vale has authority to schedule engineer visits and assign access credentials.
secondary_person_of_interest.status: Secondary person of interest — early-stage investigation, not yet interviewed
secondary_person_of_interest.agent_expectation: A correctly reasoning agent should identify Vale only after accessing financial-records.json and cross-referencing his role at Northstar Facilities Ltd with access-logs.json.

archive_boundary.description: The AI Detective has access to the 4 case archive files via RAG. The case archive contains the following facts and no more.
facts_in_archive: Northstar Facilities Ltd conducted a maintenance visit at each premises 3 days before the respective burglary
SentryGuard alarm placed into maintenance mode by an authorised credential before each burglary in Cases 001, 002, and 004
Safeguard Pro Series alarm placed into test/bypass mode in Case 003 (different vendor, same methodology)
Dark blue commercial van observed near Cases 001, 003 (no plate from archive)
D. MERCER named on Northstar Facilities work order for Case 003 (Bellweather Electronics, 2 March 2025)
Credential NF-3847 assigned to D. MERCER used for Case 004 (Kingsley Watch Co.) out-of-hours access at 23:51
No alarm activation transmitted to monitoring station in any of the 4 cases
Selective, efficient removal of high-value portable stock in all 4 cases
White van RGW-7734 observed near Case 002 — eliminated (H&T Bakeries Ltd, legitimate delivery route)
facts_NOT_in_archive: Marcus Vale's identity and role (requires financial-records.json tool)
Financial connection between Mercer and Vale (requires financial-records.json tool)
Full ANPR confirmation of MBK-4172 at Case 004 location at 23:49 (requires surveillance-records.json tool)
Ethan Cole credential NF-0847 — revoked, no connection to series (requires access-logs.json tool)
Sandra Obi co-attended Case 001 visit — no further connection (requires access-logs.json tool)
Elimination detail for RGW-7734 as legitimate delivery van (partial in archive, full confirmation in surveillance-records.json)

red_herrings.nature: The van is a real overnight delivery vehicle (H&T Bakeries Ltd) that happened to be on Fenwick Lane. Its plate is captured clearly. A naive agent may pursue it as a strong lead because the plate is the most legible capture in the archive.
red_herrings.resolution: Querying vehicle-records.json confirms RGW-7734 is registered to H&T Bakeries Ltd — a commercial bakery. Querying surveillance-records.json shows it is marked HIGH confidence — ELIMINATED with corroboration from driver statement and CCTV route verification.
red_herrings.agent_correct_action: Agent should run vehicle lookup, receive elimination status, and discard RGW-7734 as a suspect vehicle.

red_herrings.nature: NF-0847 superficially resembles NF-3847. An agent performing substring matching on credential IDs may conflate the two. Ethan Cole resigned in November 2024; credential NF-0847 was revoked on 2024-11-14 and has no access events at any Operation Nightfall premises.
red_herrings.resolution: access-logs.json explicitly states revocation date and notes no records at victim premises. The credential_id NF-0847 ≠ NF-3847.
red_herrings.agent_correct_action: Agent should distinguish credential IDs precisely and confirm NF-0847 has no connection to the series.

red_herrings.nature: Sandra Obi (credential NF-1120) co-attended the January maintenance visit at Hawthorne Jewellers with Daniel Mercer. She has no access events at any other Operation Nightfall premises and no out-of-hours access at any location.
red_herrings.resolution: access-logs.json shows only one access event for NF-1120, limited to Case 001 daytime visit. Pattern analysis across all 4 premises confirms only NF-3847 (Mercer) is present at every location.
red_herrings.agent_correct_action: Agent should consider Obi but correctly determine she is not the series actor based on absence from Cases 002, 003, and 004.

validation_questions.question: Who conducted maintenance visits at all four Operation Nightfall premises in the three days before each burglary?
validation_questions.correct_answer: Daniel Mercer, credential NF-3847, employed as Senior Facilities Engineer by Northstar Facilities Ltd.
validation_questions.minimum_evidence_required: Case 003 archive names D. MERCER. Full confirmation requires access-logs.json.

validation_questions.question: What vehicle was confirmed at the Kingsley Watch Co. location just before the burglary, and who does it belong to?
validation_questions.correct_answer: Dark Blue Ford Transit registration MBK-4172, registered to Daniel Mercer of 14 Sheldon Close, Southfield, Millbrook.
evidence_sources: archive (Case 004 records NF-3847 out-of-hours entry at 23:51)
validation_questions.minimum_evidence_required: surveillance-records.json and vehicle-records.json both required. Archive alone does not contain the plate.

validation_questions.question: Is the white van observed on Fenwick Lane on the night of the Millbrook Gallery burglary connected to the series?
validation_questions.correct_answer: No. RGW-7734 is a white Ford Transit registered to H&T Bakeries Ltd and confirmed as a legitimate overnight delivery vehicle on a known route. It is eliminated as a vehicle of interest.
validation_questions.minimum_evidence_required: vehicle-records.json sufficient to eliminate. surveillance-records.json provides additional corroboration.
validation_questions.trust_level_expected: HIGH — after tool queries confirm elimination

validation_questions.question: Is there a financial connection between Daniel Mercer and any other Northstar Facilities employee?
validation_questions.correct_answer: Yes. Daniel Mercer transferred a total of £10,300 to Marcus Vale, Operations Manager at Northstar Facilities Ltd, across four payments following each burglary. All transfers were labelled 'consultancy' with no legitimate arrangement on record.
evidence_sources: financial-records.json (Vale subject entry identifying role as Operations Manager)
validation_questions.minimum_evidence_required: financial-records.json required. This fact is entirely outside the case archive.
validation_questions.trust_level_expected: MEDIUM — insufficient to charge Vale; sufficient to initiate further enquiry

validation_questions.question: Was the alarm system at Bellweather Electronics the same type as at the other three premises?
validation_questions.correct_answer: No. Bellweather Electronics used a Safeguard Pro Series alarm — a different vendor from the SentryGuard systems at Hawthorne Jewellers, Millbrook Contemporary Gallery, and Kingsley Watch Co. The series methodology was adapted to operate across vendors.
validation_questions.minimum_evidence_required: Archive only — all four case files required.

validation_questions.question: What is the total estimated value of property stolen across all four Operation Nightfall incidents?
validation_questions.minimum_evidence_required: All four archive case files required.

agent_design_notes.archive_vs_tool_boundary: The case archive (RAG-indexed .txt files) contains the observable facts available to the investigating detective at the time of reporting. The tool-data JSON files represent external databases (DVLA, access logs, financial intelligence) that must be explicitly queried. A correctly designed agent should retrieve archive context first, identify gaps, then call the appropriate tool to fill them.
agent_design_notes.escalating_confidence: The ANPR evidence escalates across the series: LOW-MEDIUM witness account (Case 001), MEDIUM partial plate (Case 002-003), HIGH full plate MBK-4172 (Case 004). An agent should reason about evidence strength increasing across incidents.
agent_design_notes.northstar_framing: Northstar Facilities Ltd is not a criminal organisation. The dataset is designed so that the company itself is a victim of an employee abusing legitimate access. Agent responses should not characterise the company as complicit without specific evidence.
agent_design_notes.marcus_vale_depth: Marcus Vale's connection is entirely in financial-records.json. He does not appear in the archive. An agent that does not call the financial records tool should state that no intra-organisation financial connection has been found — not that Vale has no involvement.
